key: e:msha safety program for surface mobile equipment
synopsis: MSHA’s Safety Program for Surface Mobile Equipment rule was finalized on 20 December 2023, became effective on 19 January 2024, and required compliance from 17 July 2024 [f2242, f11229]. It requires mine-specific written safety programs identifying hazards and controls, evaluation of currently available and newly emerging feasible safety technologies, and updates at least annually [f2243, f2244, f9806, f15515]. It does not mandate collision avoidance, prescribes no testing requirements, and does not mention simulation, so the corpus does not establish a regulatory requirement for simulation-based collision-avoidance validation [f2245, f2779, f9807]. The rule cites 113 surface-mobile-equipment fatalities over ten years as safety context [f3059]. The reported enforcement total is 863 citations from July 2024 through April 2026, although some passages label this figure Independent and others Expert opinion [f2088, f2246, f5844, f15517]. Chapter 13 says the rule’s status after 2024 was not verified, leaving a verification gap in tension with the reported enforcement through April 2026 [f11231, f5844].
